era: The 2017-2020 weather.com design (IBM era) seen by US visitors in 2019: black top bar with the square The Weather Channel logo, location search and 'An IBM Business', a blue location band, a black forecast tab bar (Today, Hourly, 5 Day, 10 Day, Weekend, Monthly, Maps, More Forecasts), blue gradient current-conditions card and news modules. The Arquivo captures (2019-03/07/11) are the Portuguese edition served to the Lisbon crawler; the Wayback capture (2019-06, English, US) shows the US labels, and both show the same design.
